mechanism: Venlafaxine may increase serotonergic activity and sympathomimetic effects that could theoretically worsen gentamicin-induced nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through additive mechanisms; both drugs have renal clearance considerations.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and auditory symptoms during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and avoid prolonged gentamicin exposure; consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment is present.
